headline: Approved a 3% raise for bi-lingual coordinator Dario Hernandez and the final voter roll for the November 3, 2026 General Election.
summary: Members discussed problems seen on Primary Day, September 9, 2026, and reviewed reminders about upcoming classes and early voting. They approved a 3% raise for Dario Hernandez, the bi-lingual coordinator. They also approved the final voter count for the November 3, 2026 General Election, 47,771 voters.

Approved the Final Canvass of the voting rolls for the November 3, 2026 General Election, 2-0.

plain_text:
PAWTUCKETBOARD OF CANVASSERS
October 13, 2026
MONTHLY MEETING
Present were, Stella Carrera, Clerk,Marilee Arsenault, Democratic Alternate, Kenneth McGill, Registrar and
DarioHernandez, Bi-lingual Coordinator.
Absent: :  Maria Pavao, Chairperson, Robert Castle,Member.
Marilee Arsenault, DemocraticAlternate called meeting to order at 4:01 P.M.
Public Input:                                       Therewas none.
Meeting Minutes:                               Minutes were reviewedof the August 18, 2026, September 9, 2026 and
September 10, 2026, 2026 minutesby the board.
Motion to accept the August 18,2026, September 9, 2026 and September 10, 2026 meetings motion made
to accept byMarilee Arsenault, Alternate and seconded by Stella Carrera, Clerk.
Motionpasses 2-0.
New Business:                                    The board wasreminded that supervisors classes will be held on
October 22, 2026 at 11:00 amand 4:00 pm at City Hall.
Memberswere reminded that Warden/Clerk classes will be held at the City Hall Annex on October15, 2026
at 5:00 p.m. and 6:30 p.m.
Memberswere reminded that Early Voting begins on October 14, 2026 at the BlackstoneValley Visitor
Center, 175 Main St.
Inaddition, expanded Early Voting hours will be Saturday, October 24, 2026 from8:00 am to 4:00 pm and
Thursday, October 29, 2026 from 8:00 am to 7:00 pm.
Acommunication was read from Richard J. Goldstein, City Clerk regarding thereappointment of Marilee
Arsenault as the Alternate Democratic Member to theboard. Term will expire on the 1st Monday in January,
2033.
                                                            
Membersdiscussed problem and concerns that they witnessed on Primary Day – September9, 2026
Apositive performance review was presented for Dario Hernandez, Bi-lingualCoordinator  by Kenneth
McGill, Registrar.Recommendation is a 3% raise.
Motionwas made by Marilee Arsenault, Democratic Alternate and seconded by StellaCarrera, Clerk to give
the Bi-lingual Coordinator, Dario Hernandez  a 3% raise.
Motionpasses 2-0.
Membersthen conducted the Final Canvass of the voting rolls for the  November 3, 2026 General Election.
Memberswere informed that there are  40,142active voters, 567 active with NCOA change, 7,062 inactive
voters eligible tovote in the General Election for a total of 47,771.
Motionby Stella Carrera, Clerk and seconded by Marilee Arsenault, DemocraticAlternate to accept and
approve the Final Canvass for the November 3, 2026General Election.
Motionpasses – 2-0.
Beingno further business motion to adjourn by Stella Carrera, Clerk and seconded byMarilee Arsenault,
Democratic Alternate to adjourn.
Motionpasses 2-0.
Adjournat 4:47 pm.
Next meeting will be Tuesday,November 3, 2026 to conduct the General Election, Pawtucket City Hall,
137Roosevelt Ave. Room 303 at 6:00 A.M.
RespectfullySubmitted,
Stella Carrera, Clerk
